reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are exactly what I check before buying, and I never see that on TikTok Shop. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one, mostly because a sachet I can see on the counter is harder to forget than a bottle.
objection: $29.99 a month is a lot for magnesium when bottles cost less, and it is still 2 capsules every day that I will skip half the time. I would also open the report first to check it is a real lab with a real batch number.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out to be generic, missing my batch number, or from a lab I cannot find, I would not buy.
